verdict.rationale: Publishing current processing times is a fair question for a state business-filing office, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no published processing times for any transaction type. The only related item is an FAQ heading, "How do I expedite my filing?", which is a question rather than a statement of current processing times, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
